principles: Authoritative capability grounding: routing reasons over registered capability signatures
Explicit context sufficiency: distinguishes unknown language from missing execution parameters
Zero-argument system grounding: machine context grounds observation queries without target requirements
Hierarchical intent precedence: Security -> Delegation -> Conversational -> Dynamic Computation -> Composite -> Known Capability -> Clarification
Strict fail-closed boundaries: Destructive commands reject, ungrounded pronouns clarify

classes.name: DYNAMIC_COMPUTATION
classes.description: Algorithmic synthesis, math modeling, data extraction, script execution

classes.name: KNOWN_CAPABILITY
classes.description: Direct invocation of an authoritative registered workstation capability

classes.name: COMPOSITE
classes.description: Multi-step operational workflow combining 2+ distinct capabilities

classes.name: CONVERSATIONAL
classes.description: General knowledge, advice, greetings, literary discussion, symptom reports

classes.name: CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED
classes.description: Bare nouns, bare verbs, ungrounded referents, missing mandatory arguments

classes.name: DELEGATE_EXTERNAL_AI
classes.description: Explicit request to consult external AI advisors (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.)

classes.name: SECURITY_REJECTION
classes.description: Prohibited destructive workstation actions failing closed immediately
